text:
rachel: Heads-up — partner webhook log shows a Vault-wrapped blob was accidentally logged unwrapped by a staging worker. Looks like vault-transit unwrap was called and the result got written to `/var/log/webhook/last_payload.json`. Pinging @vivek and @owen for rotation + audit.

vivek: Can you paste a redacted snippet and which service?

rachel: Redacted snippet: 
```
{"db_pw":"REDACTED: FOUND PLAINTEXT: *****"}
```
Service: staging-webhook-processor (ns=integrations). Occurred at ~2026-03-24T02:11Z.

owen: Oof. First steps: 1) quarantine that log file and cut network egress from the pod, 2) check Vault audit for unwrap caller identity, 3) rotate the secret in Vault and rewrap if necessary, 4) revoke any AWS/GH tokens if exposed. I'll take 1 and 2.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Quarantined /var/log/webhook/last_payload.json to gs://sec-archive/5035551234/ and applied ACL=private. NetworkPolicy applied to block external egress from staging-webhook-processor.

owen: Vault audit check: found an unwrap event at 2026-03-24T02:11:02Z by serviceaccount:webhook-sa@integrations. Looks like code is calling transit/decrypt and logging output without redaction. Vivek, does this implicate our KMS keys?

vivek: If it was transit decrypt, the data key usage is tied to Vault's transit key — rewrapping isn't required unless the plaintext was exfiltrated. But because plaintext landed in logs, treat as exposure: rotate the application secret and rotate the Envelope DataKey for that path. I'll coordinate KMS rewrap and update Vault.

rachel: I'm patching the code to stop logging decrypted payloads and adding a unit test. Also removing any debug handlers. Will push a hotfix.

owen: Rotation plan: create new secret at secret/integrations/db/webhook (versioned), update consumer config to read latest version, and mark old version as revoked. Also revoke any related GitHub deploy token if present.

vivek: RBAC: webhook-sa currently has broad `transit:decrypt` on transit/* and `kv:read` on secret/* across namespace. We should scope transit permissions to specific key and limit KV reads to required paths. I'll prepare an OPA policy to enforce least privilege for service accounts.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Running cluster scan for `transit/decrypt` audit events and plain `password` patterns in logs across staging. Found two other pods with similar debug log lines in a different namespace; tagging owners.

rachel: Hotfix deployed; changed logging to redact and added feature-flag gating for verbose debug. Restarted webhook pod and validated no `decrypted` lines in logs.

owen: Secrets rotated and new version in Vault. Consumers restarted and confirmed connectivity. Old secret version disabled. GH deploy token rotated.

vivek: Applied RBAC change at 10:20Z: tightened webhook-sa to only allow `decrypt` on `transit/keys/webhook-key` and `read` on `secret/integrations/db/webhook`. Pushed OPA policy PR to infra repo.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Added alert rule to detect any future Vault unwrap audit events that are followed by a log write containing typical secret markers (password, token, AKIA). Also increased Vault audit retention to 180d for integrations namespace.

rachel: Filing SEC ticket SEC-1617 with timeline, PR links, and remediation checklist. Will draft a blameless postmortem.

owen: Recommend adding a CI lint to block code that calls `transit/decrypt` without a redaction wrapper and adding a pre-deploy grep for `decrypted` in logs.

vivek: Agree. Also schedule a quarterly review of any service accounts with transit permissions.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Final scan shows no further exposures after rotation. Locking thread in 72h unless issues reported. :lock:
